description: Find NGOs (associations and foundations) listed on hangel by keyword, city, cause area or minimum transparency score. Each result has a 0-100 transparency score and the link to its hangel profile.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call of this tool, to get the next page. Other arguments can be omitted; if given, they must match that call.

limit.description: Maximum number of results in this page (default 20, at most 50).

query.description: Matched against name, short name, cause area, description and beneficiary groups. Turkish or English, or German, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Persian, Azerbaijani, Hungarian, Hausa or Danish.

name: search_ngos

asOf.description: Time the statuses and dates were evaluated (ISO 8601).

hasMore.description: true when more records follow; call again with nextCursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page.

category.description: Main cause area as written on hangel.

contentLanguage.description: BCP 47 code of the language the text fields are written in, as stored on hangel (for example "tr" or "en"); "und" when it cannot be determined. Texts are not machine-translated unless "translated" is true.

translated.description: true only when the name and summary were replaced by a translation stored on hangel; the original language is then in originalLanguage.

transparencyScore.description: Transparency score 0-100 shown on the profile.

type.description: Association, foundation or other legal form.

url.description: Public page of the record on hangel.org.

offset.description: Position of the first record of this page in the full result.

query.description: Present when a query was given.

expansion.description: Query terms that were matched across languages through the hangel multilingual dictionary, and the forms searched in the content.

normalized.description: The query after case, accent and punctuation normalisation (the raw query is not echoed).

returned.description: Number of records in this page.

title: Search NGOs
